verdict.rationale: Stripe's payouts docs, which apply to funds from Terminal payments, say balances are paid out to your bank account. Instant Payouts can be sent at any time, including weekends and holidays, and usually arrive within 30 minutes, which covers the 'speed it up when I need cash' part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows per-payout arrival-date tracking or a next-day payout option. missing for 10: evidence of seeing when each payout lands (arrival dates/payout schedule view), a next-day payout speed option, payout reconciliation to Terminal transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see when each payout lands and speed it up (next-day or instant) when I need the cash

citations.quote: With Instant Payouts you can send payouts any time, including weekends and holidays, and funds usually appear in the associated bank account within 30 minutes.
